title: Dragon Ball Super
description: DBSWith Majin Boo defeated half-a-year prior, peace returns to Earth, where Son Goku (now a radish farmer) and his friends now live peaceful lives. However, a new threat appears in the form of Beerus, the God of Destruction. Considered the most terrifying being in the entire universe, Beerus is eager to fight the legendary warrior seen in a prophecy foretold decades ago known as the Super Saiyan God. The series retells the events from the two Dragon Ball Z films, Battle of Gods and Resurrection ‘F’ before proceeding to an original story about the exploration of alternate universes.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x1
episodes_data.description: Goku is farming with Goten when Mr. Satan tries to give him 100 Million Zeni! Goten and Trunks try to find a gift to Videl.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x2
episodes_data.description: Vegeta and his family go on a family trip while Goku trains. Beers remembers the Super Saiyan God in his dream.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x3
episodes_data.description: Beerus and Whis track down the Super Saiyan God. Meanwhile, Bulma and her friends set up her birthday party.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x4
episodes_data.description: The Pilaf Gang end up at Bulma's birthday party to steal the Dragon Balls, but they are sidetracked. Meanwhile, Goku trains on Kaio's planet.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x5
episodes_data.description: While Goku is training, Beerus shows up at Kaio's planet. Goku suggests that they fight against Kaio's wishes, but Goku is later beaten by Beerus as a Super Saiyan 3.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x6
episodes_data.description: Beerus arrives at Bulma's birthday party, and Vegeta tries his best to keep the God of Destruction under wraps for the time being.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x7
episodes_data.description: The Z-Fighters attempt to subdue Beerus after he gets angry, to no avail. Vegeta transforms out of rage after witnessing Bulma get slapped.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x8
episodes_data.description: An enraged Vegeta fights Beerus, but is overwhelmed. Later, Beers wins a rock-paper-scissors contest against Oolong, and decides to destroy Earth. Before he can, Goku returns.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x9
episodes_data.description: After Goku asks Beerus for more time, they summon Shen Long to find out how to achieve the Super Saiyan God form. They perform the ritual and Goku becomes a Super Saiyan God.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x10
episodes_data.description: After successfully becoming a Super Saiyan God, Goku challenges Beerus to another fight.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x11
episodes_data.description: The battle between gods continues.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x12
episodes_data.description: The destructive power of Goku and Beerus' fight puts the entire universe in danger.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x13
episodes_data.description: Although Goku loses the Super Saiyan God form, he absorbs and retains its power, and continues to fight Beerus.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x14
episodes_data.description: The fight between Goku and Beerus reaches its climactic end.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x15
episodes_data.description: After the battle with Beerus wraps up, a terrible visitor comes to Satan!?

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x16
episodes_data.description: With the battle over, one day Kuririn visits Goku. His unexpected request is…!? Meanwhile, Vegeta tries to convince Whis to make him one of his students by…?

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x17
episodes_data.description: Some time has passed on Earth. Gohan and Videl’s daughter is finally born!!

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x18
episodes_data.description: Goku departs Earth and begins training under Whis. The surprising training method is…!?

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x19
episodes_data.description: Sorbet is eager to revive Frieza and receives the help of Pilaf and his gang.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x20
episodes_data.description: Jaco travels to Earth to give out a warning of Frieza's arrival.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x21
episodes_data.description: Frieza's forces begin their raid on Planet Earth. Goku and Vegeta, oblivious to what is happening on Earth, continue their training under Whis.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x22
episodes_data.description: Ginyu switches bodies with Tagoma and wreaks havoc on the Z-Fighters

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x23
episodes_data.description: Goku and Vegeta hear of Frieza's return and quickly teleport to Earth.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x24
episodes_data.description: Goku and Frieza go one-on-one. Goku wants to reveal his true power, and so he transforms...

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x25
episodes_data.description: Frieza reveals his new evolution and the battle truly begins.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x26
episodes_data.description: The battle continues as Frieza's weakness begins to make itself obvious.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x27
episodes_data.description: With Goku badly injured, Vegeta steps in to face Frieza. Stronger than ever, Vegeta proves to be a challenge and an enraged Frieza destroys the planet! Protected by Whis, the Z-Fighters are given a chance to save Earth, if they act fast enough.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x28
episodes_data.description: While training on Beerus' Planet, Goku and Vegeta meet Beerus' twin brother Champa.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x29
episodes_data.description: Beerus and Champa decided to hold a tournament between their universes to settle who gets to use the Super Dragon Balls.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x30
episodes_data.description: Goku and Vegeta go find the two remaining members for Team Universe 7.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x31
episodes_data.description: Jaco and Bulma visit Zuno to learn more about the Super Dragon Balls.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x32
episodes_data.description: The tournament between Universe 6 and Universe 7 begins! The first match is going underway.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x33
episodes_data.description: It's Goku versus Botamo! After Goku's victory, he faces Frost, Universe 6's version of Frieza. Who wins the match...?

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x34
episodes_data.description: The next contestant for Team Universe 7 is Piccolo. Frost is doing what?!

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x35
episodes_data.description: Vegeta battles Frost. After a short-lived fight, Vegeta is challenged by Magetta.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x36
episodes_data.description: Vegeta is struggling during his match with Magetta. What is Magetta doing to Vegeta?!

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x37
episodes_data.description: The next match is between Vegeta and the Saiyan from Universe 6, Cabba. What secret power does Cabba possess?

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x38
episodes_data.description: The final contestant for Universe 6 is the confident, legendary assassin, Hit. Does Vegeta stand a chance?

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x39
episodes_data.description: The battle between Goku and Hit continues, however, Hit proves to be more formidable than anticipated.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x40
episodes_data.description: The winner of the tournament between Universe 6 and 7 is decided!

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x41
episodes_data.description: As the winners of the Tournament Universe 7 are given the Super Dragon Balls and make summon the Dragon for their wish.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x42
episodes_data.description: The Tournament may be over, but Goku still wants to battle Monaku to see how really strong he is. While Beers and the rest of Dragon Ball Cast try and keep his secret hidden from Goku.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x43
episodes_data.description: Pan is kidnapped thought to be defenseless by her captors, but as it turned out, the plan backfired.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x44
episodes_data.description: While Monaka delivers super sweets of the Galaxy to Bulma, Trunks and Goten end up locking themselves in his truck. Finding trouble on a planet Pot-au-feu, Where Vegeta and Jaco have to go and rescue them.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x45
episodes_data.description: With Vegeta losing all of his power to the copy of himself that was made from Superhuman Water, it is up to Goten and Trunks to defeat him. Mean while Goku is back at full health and training at Kaio's planet.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x46
episodes_data.description: The battle between Goku and Duplicate Vegeta Continues. Will Goku defeat the copy in time to save Vegeta?

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x47
episodes_data.description: In the timeline of Future Trunks, a new enemy appears that requires him to return to the past and get help from the Z-Fighters.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x48
episodes_data.description: Much to everyone's surprise, a war-torn and unconscious Future Trunks arrives in the past after evading Black.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x49
episodes_data.description: After awakening in the present, Future Trunks mistakes Goku for his evil look-alike Black.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x50
episodes_data.description: Goku Black invades from Trunks' future! Excited to fight a strong opponent, Goku immediately challenges him to one-on-one combat, but Goku Black isn't taking the fight seriously?!

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x51
episodes_data.description: Bulma finds the Time Machine that Cell used to travel to the past and promptly gathers the team to repair it. Future Trunks and Mai discuss their counterparts from alternate timelines.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x52
episodes_data.description: Piccolo mentions that Gohan decided to abandon his training to become a scholar, which suprised Future Trunks. Piccolo and Kuririn suggest that Future Trunks should meet their timeline's Gohan.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x53
episodes_data.description: Goku, Beerus, and Whis arrive in Universe Ten. They meet the Supreme Kai Gowasu and his apprentice Zamasu.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x54
episodes_data.description: Vegeta wants to test Future Trunks' power to see how strong his son had become.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x55
episodes_data.description: Whis and Beerus are worried over Zen-Oh's request to meet Goku and what it could mean for their universe.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x56
episodes_data.description: Goku and Vegeta appear in the future to fight Goku Black, but they find that he has developed a new power.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x57
episodes_data.description: Zamasu appears unexpectedly from the sky. He states that he and Goku Black are "kindred spirits" who want a world without mortals.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x58
episodes_data.description: Defeated, Son Goku, Vegeta and Trunks travel to the present, in order to find a way to defeat Zamasu. We also witness a developing relating to the mystery between Black and Zamasu.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x59
episodes_data.description: Goku, Beerus and Whis must save Gowasu from his treacherous apprentice.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x60
episodes_data.description: Trunks returns to the future, with Goku and his parents accompanying him. There they discover Goku Black still lives, and he explains how he defied space and time to exist.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x61
episodes_data.description: Goku, Vegeta and Future Trunks fight Black and Zamasu in the future. Black explains his true identity.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x62
episodes_data.description: With his new found power, Trunks attempts to hold off Black and Zamasu. Meanwhile, Goku and Vegeta head back to the past to try come up with a new strategy.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x63
episodes_data.description: Trunks wakes up in a rebel base only to find out that Mai set off on her own in an attempt to take out Black. Will he make it in time to save her?

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x64
episodes_data.description: As the battle rages on in the future, Bulma and Trunks devise a plan to take down Zamasu, meanwhile, Vegeta shows his new-found strength while taking on Goku Black.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x65
episodes_data.description: The two zamasu fuse and become the ultimate god. Meanwhile vegeta, goku and others are stunned and try to somehow defeat the eternal god.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x66
episodes_data.description: After Goku's attack shakes Zamazu's balance and reveal a weakness in him, he and Vegeta fuse together as they see hope to prevail. Nevertheless, It's Trunks's world and to him it all ultimately comes down.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x67
episodes_data.description: Zamasu makes one final almighty move to destroy the universe, but Goku brings out a forgotten but all-powerful ally to stop him.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x68
episodes_data.description: Goku decides to summon Shenron to honor a promise, but his friends have things they want to wish for too.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x69
episodes_data.description: Goku and the android girl Arale Norimaki meet after many years, in a fun-filled episode where the cast of Dr Slump and DBZ meet.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x70
episodes_data.description: Chanpa returns, and offers a baseball game between him and Beerus.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x71
episodes_data.description: Hit gets a contract to kill Goku, and prepares his assassination.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x72
episodes_data.description: Goku manages to come back to life, but he seeks a fight with Hit. And who is the client who put Hit to fight Goku?

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x73
episodes_data.description: A film of the Great Saiyaman is to be made, and Gohan is to be in it - to his chagrin, as a stuntman.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x74
episodes_data.description: Barry Kahn's attempts to sabotage Gohan get lethal when the alien parasite Watagash takes control of him.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x75
episodes_data.description: Krillin decides to train with Goku after a police battle goes bad, but can he match up to the Saiyan's level?

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x76
episodes_data.description: Goku and Krillin fight against their old enemies such as Frieza and Cell in a form of nightmares in a mystical forest Master Roshi sent them to in order to fetch him a special herb.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x77
episodes_data.description: Goku goes and sees Zen-O to get the Tournament of Power going.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x78
episodes_data.description: Goku gets an invitation to the Tournament of Power, an epic tournament between universes.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x79
episodes_data.description: Majin Buu and Basil the Kicker continue to give Zen-Chan a show while they unravel the fight.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x80
episodes_data.description: With Majin Buu and Basil's battle concluded, Gohan is the next warrior of Universe 7 to fight. The rusty warrior's opponent is Universe 9's Lavendar. Lavender, however, has a trick up his sleeve.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x81
episodes_data.description: The greatest fighters of Universes 7 and 9, Goku and Bergamo, face off.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x82
episodes_data.description: After Goku won his battle against Bergamo, Toppo from Universe 11 challenges Goku for a fight.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x83
episodes_data.description: With the Zen-O Exhibition Match concluded and 48 hours until the Tournament of Power, Goku and Gohan search for the 10 warriors needed to complete Universe 7's team.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x84

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x85

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x87

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x93
episodes_data.description: In a desperate move to keep the roster for the Tournament, Goku decides to revive his archenemy Frieza so he can compete.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x94
episodes_data.description: Frieza is resurrected. However, a group of assassins come for him and Goku.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x95
episodes_data.description: Frieza goes on a rampage against the assassins sent to take him out. But if he takes too long, Universe 7 is disqualified and erased from the Tournament.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x96
episodes_data.description: The Tournament of Power is finally about to begin. Goku and the rest of the team head to the World of Void, site of the battle stage.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x97
episodes_data.description: The 80 warriors assemble in the fighting arena in the World of Void and the curtain rises on the battle for survival.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x98
episodes_data.description: The Universe 7 team is hit by a concentrated attack from the other universes.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x99
episodes_data.description: The Universes get a taste of what it's like to be erased, after universe 9 is wiped out of existence, Krillin begins showcasing his newly-found powers. Universe 7 loses it's first participant.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x100
episodes_data.description: Kale unleashes her berserk Saiyan ability, but endangers her fellow teammates.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x101
episodes_data.description: The Pride Troopers of Universe 11 launch an assault on Goku's team.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x102
episodes_data.description: The Universe 2 lady fighters make their move.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x103
episodes_data.description: Gohan goes up against Universe 10 warriors.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x104
episodes_data.description: Hit and Dispo begin to fight at the speed of light. Hit is disadvantaged when Goku comes to help.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x105
episodes_data.description: Master Roshi takes on the fighters of Universe 4.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x106
episodes_data.description: An unknown sniper with incredible aim launches a stealth attack in the Tournament.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x107
episodes_data.description: Frost recalls how Champa promised to pardon his crimes if he humiliated and defeated Universe 7.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x108
episodes_data.description: As Gohan Struggles, Freeza and Frost appear... together they approach Gohan! What!?

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x109
episodes_data.description: The Tournament of Power is now half over, and Jiren finally attacks.  Goku is forced to Super Saiyan Blue to keep pace with the overwhelming power of the 11th Universes most powerful warrior.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x110
episodes_data.description: After a surprise counter by Jiren, Goku disappears inside the blast of his spirit bomb. Will this be the end for Universe 7?!

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x111
episodes_data.description: Hit uses his time-skip powers against Jiren and pools all his energy in a final attack to defeat him. Is this the end of Jiren?!

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x112
episodes_data.description: Vegeta and Cabba stand to face Monna from Universe 4 to show the power of the proud warrior race.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x113
episodes_data.description: Exhausted from his battle with jiren, Goku and Caulifla fight.  Goku doesn’t have the strength to transform into a Super Saiyan yet, but he slowly gains his strength back during their fight.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x114
episodes_data.description: Kale controls that fierce power and becomes a true legendary Super Saiyan!

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x115
episodes_data.description: Kefla was born from the Potara fusion.  Her power and speed are unbelievable!  Goku has to fight Kefla using his Blue Kiao Ken in the Ultimate Saiyan showdown!

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x116
episodes_data.description: Goku unleashes stupendous ki.  In his battle with Kafla, he has once more reached Ultra Instinct.  His body unconsciously dodges Kafla's attacks, which triggers her to launch an even fiercer assault.  Then after avoiding her attack, Goku fires a Kamehameha at point-blank range!

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x117
episodes_data.description: Ribrianne targets Goku right as he's worn out from an intense battle!  But then 17 and 18 appear!  18 takes Goku's place and challenges Ribrianne to one-on-one combat, while 17 takes on Rozie.  Can the two of them prevail against Universe 2's strongest?!

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x118
episodes_data.description: Gohan and Piccolo's tough fight!  Gohan and Piccolo struggle against the desperate attacks of Universe 6's final warriors, Saonel and Pirina!  Piccolo therefore thinks up a method of attack their opponents won't expect.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x119
episodes_data.description: The Tournament of Power Continues and Universe 7 takes on Universe 4.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x120
episodes_data.description: Universe 3's Menacing Assassins attack Universe 7.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x121
episodes_data.description: Universe 7's all-out war begins with the quadruple Merge from Universe 3 named Aniraza. Goku and all his team members take on the new opponent.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x122
episodes_data.description: With 7 minutes remaining the fight to determine who will survive, Vegeta challenges the strongest warrior Jiren.  What!?

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x123
episodes_data.description: Vegeta puts his full power in display against the mighty warrior Jiren of Universe 11, but can he hold his ground against him?

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x124
episodes_data.description: Frieza is about to eliminate Dyspo, but Dyspo suddenly shows his true power. Can Universe 7 be able to defeat this warrior with Lightning Speed?

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x125
episodes_data.description: The Battle continues between Toppo and Android 17 but Toppo displays the power of a God of Destruction. Can this obstacle be destroyed?

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x126
episodes_data.description: Vegeta displays his full power against Toppo in this high heated Match. Can Vegeta be able to defeat him with his Final Trick?

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x127
episodes_data.description: Android 17, Vegeta, Goku and Frieza maximize their struggle to defeat Jiren. Jiren releases his hidden power that surprises everyone. Android 17 shows Jiren his bravery and tries to mentally steer him into defeat. 17, protects Vegeta and Goku from a lethal attack from Jiren.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x128
episodes_data.description: While Goku tries to master the Ultra Instinct, Vegeta still fights Jiren with everything he's got.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x129
episodes_data.description: A super heated battle for survival continues. With Jiren puttin Goku on the ropes even after he awakens ultra instict Goku surrpasses his limits once again by mastering the ultra instict.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x130
episodes_data.description: The climactic battle to decide the fate of Universe 7 continues as Goku, now mastering Ultra Instinct, fights Jiren at his full power.

episodes_data.title: Dragon Ball Super 1x131
episodes_data.description: The Tournament of Power reaches its final climactic moment, as Goku, Frieza and 17 have to eliminate Jiren for the survival of Universe 7.
